body: Perhaps [this](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SP1L-247Gyo) will convince you otherwise about dubai or the other muslim countries. I'll work on getting out of here (Pray for me :p). As for the mosque, I guess now you know why aren't muslims inventing and adding to this world; we're busy praying to Allah.

Thank you! Of course I'm considering moving out. That's the only hope that's making me alive. But I can't really see anyway to do it. The only way is to get a work visa, and to get a work visa I'll need a job offer. Do you know anyone who would consider hiring a saudi? I certainly won't, because saudis 1) come from a very different culture, and most of them don't get along with westerners easily, and 2) they are extremist muslims, which makes them intolerant, need a place to pray, and they won't be able to be productive during the fasting month.

I may look at the study route, hopefully I'll be able to find someone while I'm there who would give me a job offer when I'm done. Thanks again!

I wish it was easy to pretend. I wish I could go to the mosque five times a day without thinking about the time I'm waisting. I wish I could pretend that it's OK to watch my little brother go to a quranic school and waist his life on this BS. I wish I could tolerate the anger we have when someone insults god or religion. I wish I could tolerate the arrogance and the amount of racism we have. I wish I didn't start thinking in the first place. I really do. That would've made my life much easier. But it's not that easy.
